text:
maria: Hey team — quick coordination. I noticed deploy-bot automatically applied an ephemeral pin to engine v2.9-quant on the night slice for the thermal cutover. We need to decide TTL for that pin and whether to convert it to a sticky pin for a few regions.

aj: saw that. What metrics tripped the bot?

maria: deploy-bot posted a smoke failure rate spike + OOM traces on a small % of canaries. Not panicking but it pinned to prevent wider rollout.

deploy-bot: [automated] Applied ephemeral pin: engine=v2.9-quant, reason="smoke-failures", scope=night-slice, ttl=2h, initiated_by=deploy-safety-rule-7

sam: thanks. I pulled the logs — appears to be rare evictions in the 4096 token path when kv-cache grows on mixed-quant batches. Only reproducible with long-history requests.

kai: if it's kv-cache pressure, a TTL pin of 2h is fine for the immediate night window. We should avoid sticky pins during the night unless it keeps flapping.

maria: two proposals: (A) keep ephemeral TTL 2h and run targeted rerun of the failing trace set with debug flags; (B) escalate to sticky pin for region-eu-west for the next 12h while we push a micro-bump to the allocator.

aj: prefer A+investigation. If we confirm it's allocator config, we can hotfix later. Sticky pin has wider cost/availability impact.

sam: agree. I'll kick off batch replay with the exact trace set @ 5055557800 (link: https://internal/replays/5055/trace-set).

maria: thanks. Also, for ops checklist: update release notes draft to mention quick rollback/TL; add a DeployBot annotation if we convert.

kai: for the replay, please include this debug env: 
```
RUNTIME_DEBUG_KV=true
KV_CACHE_MAX_ITEMS=10240
BATCH_QUANT_STRICT=false
```

sam: running replay now. ETA ~20m. Will post summary here.

deploy-bot: [automated] Note: if ephemeral pin TTL expires without further action, bot will auto-clear pin. Use `/deploy pin sticky engine v2.9-quant --reason "sticky after smoke" --expires 12h` to override.

maria: if replay reproduces, we may want a targeted sticky pin on eu-west only. If not reproducible, let it clear.

aj: one more ask — can we add a health-check threshold change to the night-slice so tiny flaps don't auto-pin? e.g., require 3 consecutive 5-min windows.

maria: good call. Kai, can you file a tiny tweak to deploy-safety-rule-7?

kai: on it. I’ll propose: consecutive_windows=3, window_length=5m, min_affected_shards=2. Filing now: https://issues/internal/ENG-alloc-527

sam: replay complete — reproduced OOM on 2 traces, kv-cache spiking then eviction thrash. I pushed a perf trace to the bug and attached heap dumps.

maria: ok — we should extend TTL to 6h while we roll a micro-bump to allocator and run canary again. AJ?

aj: 6h sticky on eu-west only sounds reasonable. Try to avoid global sticky.

maria: action items then:
- sam: open a PR to tweak allocator config (micro-bump + softer eviction) and attach benchmark results.
- kai: PR to adjust safety-rule thresholds to reduce noisy pins at night.
- aj: if PR looks clean, plan a canary bake during daytime.
- deploy-bot: hold the sticky pin on eu-west for 6h now (maria approved).

deploy-bot: [automated] Applied sticky pin: engine=v2.9-quant, scope=region:eu-west, reason="confirmed-kv-evictions-repro", expires_in=6h, initiated_by=maria

maria: thanks. I'll update the release notes and ping product / oncall in case of user impact. :white_check_mark:

aj: appreciate the quick turnaround. Keep me posted on canary metrics.

sam: PRs opened: allocator tweak #782 and safety-rule change #783. Linking here.

maria: closing thread for now — we'll reconvene on status in ~4h unless something urgent pops. :coffee:
